visualCharacteristics: A full-width key-visual banner carousel with linked image slides, prev/next arrows, progress dots and a pause button. It autoplays every five seconds and supports swipe.
contentPattern: One row per slide: [link paragraph wrapping the desktop picture] [mobile picture]. The mobile picture is moved into the same link so one link serves both renditions.
usage: Use it for the homepage hero with rotating promotional banners.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for image-only linked banner rotations; pick hero for a single static banner or carousel when slides carry text content.
